shapeSummary: Shaftless coin vibration motor: a 10 mm diameter, 3.4 mm tall solid cylinder with its axis along Y and its bottom at Y=0, centered on X and Z. A small solder tab and two short stub leads (0.5 mm diameter) extend radially along +X from one edge, at the mid-upper height of the disc.
warnings: Dimensions (10 mm diameter, 3.4 mm height) come from the unverified spec text.
The image analysis describes the axis along Z, but the brief requires the bottom at Y=0, so the disc axis is along Y.
The lead length and diameter are estimated, and the leads are truncated to short stubs. Real flying leads are much longer.
The tab size and position are estimated from the image.
The small central dimple on the top face and the notches along the bottom rim are not modeled because they are too small or uncertain.
The logo watermark is not modeled.
The lead insulation colors cannot be represented in the geometry.
cadquery:
d=10.0
h=3.4
# Coin motor body: disc axis along Y, bottom at Y=0, centered on X and Z
body = cq.Workplane('XZ').circle(d/2).extrude(-h)
# Small solder tab block at one edge, where the leads attach
tab = cq.Workplane('XY').box(0.8, 1.6, 1.8, centered=(False, False, True)).translate((d/2 - 0.1, h/2 - 0.8, 0))
# Two short stub leads (red and blue) leaving radially along +X, merged into one solid
lead1 = cq.Workplane('YZ').center(h/2 + 0.3, 0.5).circle(0.25).extrude(4.0).translate((d/2 + 0.6, 0, 0))
lead2 = cq.Workplane('YZ').center(h/2 - 0.3, -0.5).circle(0.25).extrude(4.0).translate((d/2 + 0.6, 0, 0))
part = body.union(tab).union(lead1).union(lead2)
